data_note: Built from publisher RSS metadata (titles + teaser text). `coverage_window_hours` is the default (40h); several feeds use a longer `rollingHours` (see `scripts/build-digest.mjs`) so rows align with what is still on each publisher’s listing pages. section_overviews.commercial_observer:
Zara Doubles Footprint at a Macerich Shopping Center in Los Angeles County: Fashion firm Zara is more than doubling its footprint at a Southern California shopping center. The clothing retailer is expanding from 22,000 square feet to a 45,000-square-foot flagship opening next year at Macerich ’s 1.3 million-square-foot Los Cerritos Center in southeast Los Angeles County.

British Luxury Fashion Brand JW Anderson to Open at SoHo’s 138 Wooster Street: British luxury fashion label JW Anderson has leased 4,500 square feet at 138 Wooster Street in Manhattan’s SoHo neighborhood for its first stand-alone U.S. store, Commercial Observer has learned.

Solidcore Signs Lease for Fitness Studio at 1695 Second Avenue on Upper East Side: A strength training brand has signed a retail lease on Manhattan’s Upper East Side. Solidcore , a national fitness chain that offers high-intensity workouts, took the entire retail component of Alchemy-ABR Investment Partners ’ 1695 Second Avenue , a new 23-story, 51-unit residential building on East 88th Street,.

Happier Grocery to Open Second NYC Location on the Upper East Side: A healthy grocery retailer is opening its second New York City location on Manhattan’s Upper East Side. Happier Grocery has signed a 20,500-square-foot lease at CSC Real Estate ’s 210 East 86th Street , where it plans to open a health food store like its original one on Canal Street in the second half of 2027,.
section_overviews.cre_daily:
Retail Demand Grows as Construction Hits Record Low: US retailers posted a net gain of 127 stores through Aug. 28, adding 28.6M SF of occupied retail space.

Invesco REIT Buys Raleigh Retail Center for $87.2M: Invesco REIT acquired Knightdale Marketplace for $87.2M, including closing and leasing costs, according to AltsWire. The 323,113 SF shopping center is 100% leased with a weighted average lease term of about seven years.

Core Retail Sales Hit Record as In-Store Spending Rises: Core retail sales rose 1.2% in August and 5.6% year over year, with gains across nine of 10 major retail categories. Store-based sales increased 0.6%, outpacing headline inflation and marking the second-largest monthly gain in the past 14 months.

Retail Foot Traffic Splits as August Sales Rise 5.3%: August retail sales increased 5.3% year over year and core retail rose 4.9%, according to Colliers data citing GlobalData and Placer.ai. Theaters and music venues posted a 58.3% traffic increase, while hobbies, gifts, and crafts rose 20.1%.

Former Connecticut housing authority exec charged with $16.2 million loan fraud: Robert Cappelletti was charged with committing the crimes while heading up Meriden Housing Authority.

The clothing retailer is expanding from 22,000 square feet to a 45,000-square-foot flagship opening next year at Macerich ’s 1.3 million-square-foot Los Cerritos Center in southeast Los Angeles County. Zara’s existing store will remain open during construction. The property is at 239 Los Cerritos Center near the border between L.A. and Orange counties.…

items.headline: Retail Demand Grows as Construction Hits Record Low
items.summary: US retailers posted a net gain of 127 stores through Aug. 28, adding 28.6M SF of occupied retail space. Retail recorded 10.2M SF of positive Q2 net absorption while vacancy remained near 4.4%. Q2 completions fell to a record-low 5.2M SF as construction costs continued to outpace rent growth across most markets. Key Takeaways Bisnow reports that US retail leasing and store growth are accelerating while new construction remains constrained. Coresight Research counted a net gain of 127 store openings through Aug.…

items.headline: Invesco REIT Buys Raleigh Retail Center for $87.2M
items.summary: Invesco REIT acquired Knightdale Marketplace for $87.2M, including closing and leasing costs, according to AltsWire. The 323,113 SF shopping center is 100% leased with a weighted average lease term of about seven years. The REIT raised $79.2M quarter to date through August, nearly double the $46.2M reported through July. Key Takeaways AltsWire reports that Invesco Real Estate Income Trust bought the Raleigh-area retail center for $87.2M.…

items.headline: British Luxury Fashion Brand JW Anderson to Open at SoHo’s 138 Wooster Street
items.summary: British luxury fashion label JW Anderson has leased 4,500 square feet at 138 Wooster Street in Manhattan’s SoHo neighborhood for its first stand-alone U.S. store, Commercial Observer has learned. Founded in 2008 by Jonathan Anderson — the newly appointed creative director of Dior and a two-time British Fashion Awards Designer of the Year recipient — the influential fashion label is staking out a claim in a highly sought-after part of SoHo at a time when quality retail space in the neighborhood is increasingly…

items.headline: Core Retail Sales Hit Record as In-Store Spending Rises
items.summary: Core retail sales rose 1.2% in August and 5.6% year over year, with gains across nine of 10 major retail categories. Store-based sales increased 0.6%, outpacing headline inflation and marking the second-largest monthly gain in the past 14 months. Preliminary Q3 2026 data showed positive net absorption across single- and multi-tenant retail, with supply roughly in line with demand. Key Takeaways Consumer spending strengthened broadly in August, supporting both online and physical retail.…

items.headline: Happier Grocery to Open Second NYC Location on the Upper East Side
items.summary: A healthy grocery retailer is opening its second New York City location on Manhattan’s Upper East Side. Happier Grocery has signed a 20,500-square-foot lease at CSC Real Estate ’s 210 East 86th Street , where it plans to open a health food store like its original one on Canal Street in the second half of 2027, according to landlord broker Avison Young .…

items.headline: Retail Foot Traffic Splits as August Sales Rise 5.3%
items.summary: August retail sales increased 5.3% year over year and core retail rose 4.9%, according to Colliers data citing GlobalData and Placer.ai. Theaters and music venues posted a 58.3% traffic increase, while hobbies, gifts, and crafts rose 20.1%. Grocery sales declined 0.5% and traffic was nearly flat, showing a more cautious pattern in essential spending. Key Takeaways Colliers reports in its August retail sales and traffic update that retail foot traffic split sharply by category while spending stayed resilient.…

items.headline: Men’s Grooming Club John Allan’s Moves to 4 East 46th Street
items.summary: A men’s grooming and hair brand is moving its flagship location to Midtown East. John Allan’s signed a 3,000-square-foot lease at Jeong Hoon Kim ’s 4 East 46th Street , where it will provide an exclusive experience for its members in a relocation from 575 Fifth Avenue , according to tenant broker CBRE . The length of the lease was not disclosed, but asking rent for the building was $60 per square foot, according to CBRE.…

items.headline: Toys R Us Bets on Brick and Mortar With 120 New Stores
items.summary: Toys R Us operator WHP Global has an ambitious plan to open 120 U.S. stores this holiday season. The private equity-backed brand-management company partnered with Go! Retail Group , a seasonal pop-up operator, to launch the new locations, according to an announcement last week . Shoppers nationwide can expect the new stores to be on the smaller side, the Boston Globe reported , and only temporary.…

items.headline: Sephora’s Meatpacking District Store Relocates to 401 West 14th Street
items.summary: Beauty retailer Sephora is taking a walk up the block to 401 West 14th Street . The makeup giant has signed a 4,200-square-foot deal with landlords Taconic Partners and Nuveen Real Estate to relocate its Meatpacking District store one block north from 21-27 Ninth Avenue , according to the landlords. Cushman & Wakefield ’s Jason Greenstone represented the landlords, while Virginia Pittarelli of Retail by MONA negotiated the deal on behalf of Sephora.…

items.headline: Restaurant Traffic Falls 2.4% Across US in August
items.summary: US dining visits fell 2.4% year over year in August, reversing gradual improvement recorded in June and July. Overall retail visits still rose 0.3%, but growth slowed sharply from 1.7% in July. September traffic will help show how much of August’s restaurant weakness came from calendar timing versus softer demand. Key Takeaways GlobeSt reports that US dining visits fell broadly in August while retail traffic remained slightly positive .…

items.headline: Educational Nonprofit Signs Lease to Build Campus on Brooklyn’s Floyd Bennett Field
items.summary: The National Park Service has leased a 7-acre space in Brooklyn’s Marine Park neighborhood to a workforce development nonprofit. Runway Green signed a 60-year agreement with the federal government to build a $60 million agricultural and environmental education facility at Floyd Bennett Field , according to the organization. The former airfield near Jamaica Bay is within Gateway National Recreation Area, which the Park Service oversees.…

items.summary: At an event of nearly 150 members and guests on Wednesday night, the Real Estate Board of New York (REBNY) recognized the most influential retail deals completed in New York City in the past year. REBNY evaluated retail sales, leasing and development transactions regardless of size and complexity, ranging from large apparel manufacturer leases to luxury hotel redevelopments. The board awarded three winners.…

items.headline: Toys R Us Plans 120 Holiday Stores in Retail Push
items.summary: Toys R Us plans 120 temporary standalone stores for the holiday season, compared with 36 permanent US locations. The pop-ups expand a 2023 strategy that used 24 temporary stores, while the brand also adds airport and shop-in-shop formats. National retail vacancy was 4.2% at the end of June, with limited new construction keeping available space relatively tight. Key Takeaways Toys R Us is preparing a major temporary store expansion for the holiday season.…

items.summary: A cafe serving Asian and American cuisine is opening a fourth Manhattan location, Commercial Observer has learned. Café Hestia , a group of family-run delis, has signed a 20-year, 8,000-square-foot lease at the base of the Feil Organization ’s 570 Lexington Avenue , which it will likely also use as a catering facility, according to tenant broker Kassin Sabbagh Realty (KSR).…

items.headline: Stroller Brand Uppababy Relocates Store to 156 Montague Street in Brooklyn Heights
items.summary: Known for its distinctive strollers, baby gear brand Uppababy is relocating its store within Brooklyn, Commercial Observer has learned. The high-end baby accessories brand is opening a 3,780-square-foot brick-and-mortar location at Owen Realty ’s 156 Montague Street in Brooklyn Heights, according to broker JLL . Uppababy will move next year from 90 Smith Street in Cobble Hill, where it established its Brooklyn retail and service “hub” in about 2019.…
